name: smwgraphics-redrawn-ground-pound-koopa
title: Redrawn Ground Pound Koopa
description:
A Redrawn-styled GFX for the Ground Pound Koopa custom sprite. I made it on Kai's request, and now it's released for free usage on your hacks! Use the palette that comes with Super Mario World Redrawn to make it look like the screenshots.

Enjoy!
